translations.web: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
translations.bsb: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
translations.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall ➔ also bear the image of the heavenly.
